FEB Game Leaders

Source: R/feb.R
feb_leaders.Rd

Each team's top players of one FEB game by points, rebounds, assists and fouls.

Endpoint: GET https://intrafeb.feb.es/LiveStats.API/api/v1/Ranking/{game_id}

One row per team, category and ranked player (rank 1 = the leader, in the order the feed lists them).

Usage

feb_leaders(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(integer required): FEB game id, e.g. 2535725; the game_id column of feb_schedule(), feb_results() and feb_overview().

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerFEB game id (one global sequence): the {gameId} of every LiveStats route and the p= of Partido.aspx. Game bodies do not print it, so it comes from the request.
team_sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home or away (the feed's TEAM[0] / TEAM[1], or its 1/2 and 0/1 side codes, normalised).
team_idintegerTeam-season id (key space: FEB team registrations; a NEW id every season, e.g. HLA Alicante = 979989 in 2025-26 and 1008687 in 2026-27). Joins the schedule's home_team_id / away_team_id; not a club or player id.
teamcharacterTeam name as registered for the season (sponsor name, uppercase: 'HLA ALICANTE').
categorycharacterLeader category: points, rebounds, assists or fouls (the feed's Puntos, Rebotes, Asistencias, Faltas).
rankintegerPlace in the team's category list, 1 = the leader, in the order the feed lists them.
player_idintegerFEB person id: stable across seasons and clubs (A. Jorda Rodriguez = 1676991 in 2025-26 and 2026-27). Joins the box score, play-by-play, shots and leaders; not the per-season licence_id.
shirt_numbercharacterShirt number (dorsal) as a string, so '00' and '0' stay distinct. The shot feed names the shooter by this number.
playercharacterPlayer name as 'I. SURNAME(S)', uppercase ('V. AGUILAR HERNANDEZ').
starterlogicalTrue when the player was in the starting five (the page's I column), false when on the bench.
captainlogicalTrue for the team captain. Null on 2020-21 games, where the feed does not send it.
valueintegerThe player's count in the row's category (points, rebounds, assists or personal fouls).

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in feb_game_info().

 feb_leaders(game_id = 2535725)

See also

Other FEB Functions: feb_game_info(), feb_overview(), feb_pbp(), feb_period_scores(), feb_player_box(), feb_results(), feb_schedule(), feb_shots(), feb_standings(), feb_team_stats()
